segments.text: American Fork City Council — Regular Session — December 11, 2018:

Mr. Bunker reported the Fitness Center was sponsoring a "maintain, don't gain" program. Many in the community and members of staff were participating. He reported they would hold the annual Health and Fitness Fair where blood sugar and heart rate testing would be offered. He also reported the Police Department had an event called Shop with a Cop. Officers took children to breakfast and used a $175 gift card to purchase whatever the children wanted. Mr. Bunker reported they would be holding a Community Survey online for residents to gauge how American Fork City was performing. He encouraged residents to take the survey. He noted the cemetery had a new directory for every gravesite that was covered, lit, and listed everyone who is interred in cemetery.
